name: Saidani Umetarou
source:
A forward, direct person who is very self-confident and never bashful. Fascinated by new people and knowledge, but he can be quick to change, and may lose interest quickly.

[From [url=http://hajimenokizu.com/bakumatsu-renka-shinsengumi/basic_info.html]BRS no Koibito[/url]]
